data.raw_text:
ADVISORY: The Philippines will host the 14th WorldSkills ASEAN Manila 2025, convened by the Technical Education and Skills Development Authority (TESDA) from August 21 to 31.

The opening ceremony will be on August 25 at the Marriott Grand Ballroom; the main competition dates will be on August 26 to 28 at the World Trade Center; and the closing ceremony will take place on August 30 at the SMX Convention Center Manila, all located in Pasay City.

Motorists are advised to avoid the said venues as the event is expected to draw over thousands of attendees, including competition participants, students, teachers, representatives from education and government sector, industry partners, and the public.  

The MMDA will deploy at least 85 personnel to implement traffic management measures and emergency preparedness along key routes in Metro Manila - from the airport to billeting hotels, competition venues, and other official engagement areas - in close coordination with the Philippine National Police (PNP), local traffic units, and concerned government agencies. #mmda
